G2400.et: second person singular imperative middle voice of (1492)
G2400.def: second person singular imperative middle voice of «1492»; used as imperative lo!; --behold, lo, see.

G2401.def: of Hebrew origin («0123»); Idumaea (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine:--Idumaea.

G2402.et: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat)
G2402.def: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat): perspiration:--sweat.

G2403.def: of Hebrew origin («0348»); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher):--Jezabel.

G2404.def: from «2413» and «4172»; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor:--Hierapolis.

G2405.def: from «2407»; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the priesthood, priest's office.

G2406.def: from «2407»; the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively):--priesthood.

G2407.def: prolongation from «2409»; to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions:--execute the priest's office.

G2408.def: of Hebrew origin («03414»); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite:--Jeremiah.

G2409.def: from «2413»; a priest (literally or figuratively):--(high) priest.

G2410.def: of Hebrew origin («03405»); Jericho, a place in Palestine:--Jericho.

G2411.def: neuter of «2413»; a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas «3485» denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere):--temple.

G2412.def: from «2413» and the same as «4241»; reverent:--as becometh holiness.

G2414.def: of Hebrew origin («03389»); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim}, the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare «2419».

G2415.def: from «2414»; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of Jerusalem.

G2416.def: from «2417»; to be a temple-robber (figuratively):--commit sacrilege.

G2417.def: from «2411» and «4813»; a temple-despoiler:--robber of churches.

G2418.et: from a compound of (2411) and the base of (2041)
G2418.def: from a compound of «2411» and the base of «2041»; to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively):--minister.

G2419.def: of Hebrew origin («03389»); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare «2414».

G2420.def: from «2413»; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office:--priesthood.

G2421.def: of Hebrew origin («03448»); Jessae (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite:--Jesse.

G2422.def: of Hebrew origin («03316»); Jephthae (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite:--Jephthah.

G2423.def: of Hebrew origin («03204»); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite:--Jechonias.

G2424.def: of Hebrew origin («03091»); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites:--Jesus.

G2425.et: from hiko [hikano or hikneomai, akin to (2240)] (to arrive)
G2425.def: from hiko (hikano or hikneomai, akin to «2240») (to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), i.e. ample (in amount) or fit (in character):--able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

G2427.def: from «2425»; to enable, i.e. qualify:--make able (meet).

G2428.et: from a derivative of the base of (2425) (through the idea of approaching for a favour)
G2428.def: from a derivative of the base of «2425» (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.

G2430.def: perhaps from «1504»; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor:--Iconium.

G2431.def: from the same as «2436»; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt or willing:--cheerful.

G2433.et: middle voice from the same as (2436)
G2433.def: middle voice from the same as «2436»; to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious:--be merciful, make reconciliation for.

G2435.def: neuter of a derivative of «2433»; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.

G2436.et: perhaps from the alternate form of (138)
G2436.def: perhaps from the alternate form of «138»; cheerful (as attractive), i.e. propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it:--be it far, merciful.

G2437.et: from an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation
G2437.def: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation: (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe:--Illyricum.

G2438.def: perhaps from the same as «260»; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge):--latchet, thong.

G2440.et: from a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on)
G2440.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer):--apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

G2442.et: middle voice from himeros (a yearning, of uncertain affinity)
G2442.def: middle voice from himeros (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for:--be affectionately desirous.

G2443.et: probably from the same as the former part of (1438) (through the demonstrative idea, cf (3588))
G2443.def: probably from the same as the former part of «1438» (through the demonstrative idea; compare «3588»); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result):--albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare «3363».

G2444.def: from «2443» and «5101»; for what reason ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.

G2445.def: of Hebrew origin («03305»); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine:--Joppa.

G2446.def: of Hebrew origin («03383»); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine:--Jordan.

G2447.et: perhaps from eimi (to go) or hiemi (to send)
G2447.def: perhaps from eimi (to go) or hiemi (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents):--poison, rust.

G2448.def: of Hebrew origin (3063 or perhaps «03194»); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine:--Judah.

G2449.def: feminine of «2453» (with «1093» implied); the Judaean land (i.e. Judaea), a region of Palestine:--Judaea.

G2450.def: from «2453»; to become a Judaean, i.e. "Judaize":--live as the Jews.

G2451.def: from «2453»; Judaic, i.e. resembling a Judaean:--Jewish.

G2452.def: adverb from «2451»; Judaically or in a manner resembling a Judaean:--as do the Jews.

G2453.et: from (2448) (in the sense of (2455) as a country)
G2453.def: from «2448» (in the sense of «2455» as a country); Judaean, i.e. belonging to Jehudah:--Jew(-ess), of Judaea.

G2454.def: from «2450»; "Judaism", i.e. the Jewish faith and usages:--Jews' religion.

G2455.def: of Hebrew origin («03063»); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region:--Juda(-h, -s); Jude.

G2456.def: feminine of the same as «2457»; Julia, a Christian woman:--Julia.

G2457.def: of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion:--Julius.

G2458.def: of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian:--Junias.

G2459.def: of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christian:--Justus.

G2460.def: from «2462»; an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps:--horseman.

G2461.def: neuter of a derivative of «2462»; the cavalry force:--horse(-men).

G2463.et: perhaps from (2046) (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities)
G2463.def: perhaps from «2046» (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.

G2464.def: of Hebrew origin («03327»); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of Abraham:--Isaac.

G2465.def: from «2470» and «32»; like an angel, i.e. angelic:--equal unto the angels.

G2466.def: of Hebrew origin («03485»); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant):--Issachar.

G2467.def: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of «1942»; to know:--know.

G2468.def: second person imperative present of «1510»; be thou:--+ agree, be, × give thyself wholly to.

G2469.def: of Hebrew origin (probably «0377» and «07149»); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor:--Iscariot.

G2470.et: probably from (1492) (through the idea of seeming)
G2470.def: probably from «1492» (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind):--+ agree, as much, equal, like.

G2471.def: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity:--equal(-ity).

G2472.def: from «2470» and «5092»; of equal value or honor:--like precious.

G2474.def: of Hebrew origin («03478»); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively):--Israel.

G2475.def: from «2474»; an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively):--Israelite.

G2476.et: a prolonged form of a primary stao {stah'-o} (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses)
G2476.def: a prolonged form of a primary stao stah'-o (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively):--abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare «5087».

G2477.def: from a derivative of «1492»; to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by implication) to visit for information (interview):--see.

G2478.def: from «2479»; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

G2479.et: from a derivative of is (force, cf eschon, a form of (2192))
G2479.def: from a derivative of is (force; compare eschon, a form of «2192»); forcefulness (literally or figuratively):--ability, might(-ily), power, strength.

G2480.def: from «2479»; to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively):--be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

G2481.def: adverb from «2470»; likely, i.e. perhaps:--it may be.

G2482.def: probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe:--Italy.

G2483.def: from «2482»; Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia:--Italian.

G2484.def: of Hebrew origin («03195»); Ituraea (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine:--Ituraea.

G2485.def: diminutive from «2486»; a petty fish:--little (small) fish.

G2487.def: from ikneomai (to arrive; compare «2240»); a track (figuratively):--step.

G2488.def: of Hebrew origin («03147»); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an Israelite:--Joatham.

G2489.def: feminine of the same as «2491»; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.

G2490.def: a form of «2491»; Joannas, an Israelite:--Joannas.

G2491.def: of Hebrew origin («03110»); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites:--John.

G2492.def: of Hebrew origin («0347»); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch:--Job.

G2493.def: of Hebrew origin («03100»); Joel, an Israelite:--Joel.

G2494.def: probably for «2491» or «2495»; Jonan, an Israelite:--Jonan.

G2495.def: of Hebrew origin («03124»); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites:--Jonas.

G2496.def: of Hebrew origin («03141»); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.

G2498.def: of Hebrew origin («03092»); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite:--Josaphat.

G2499.def: genitive case of «2500»; Jose, an Israelite:--Jose.
